summary: Pierce County summit lookout: L-4 cab dated 1931 and removed in 1956 (one source says destroyed); few signs remain, reached on foot through Norse Peak Wilderness.

The register, WillhiteWeb and the Forest Service say removed in 1956 (WillhiteWeb adds 'or destroyed'); firelookout.com says destroyed. The sources do not say how the cab came down

notes_for_editor: Built 1931 and removal 1956 are agreed by the register, WillhiteWeb and the Forest Service (which says the 1930s); firelookout.com alone says destroyed. The 1944 newspaper item is dated February 25, 1944 but describes a summer without a year, so the year of service is unverified; Forest Lookouts attributes it to the Prescott Evening Courier (Arizona), and the original newspaper would settle it. No Forest Service heritage record or NRHP nomination was found. WillhiteWeb's 2026 summit photographs were not examined as images, so the 'few signs' claim rests on its text.
